request.purpose: Epidemiological research on age and sex differences in chronic disease prevalence for a European comparison study.
request.question: How many people with depression were prescribed an SSRI at any time, per region?
definitions: Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
SSRI ever = any prescription with an ATC code starting with N06AB, regardless of start or end date.
Report per region: patients with depression and how many of them have SSRI ever.
